
## Setup

```{r}
library(tidyverse)  # read_csv and mutate
library(lme4)       # lmer
library(emmeans)    # emmeans and pairs
library(lmerTest)
library(ordinal)
library(performance)
library(modelsummary)
library(lmerTest)

df_params <- read_csv('/Users/sm6511/Desktop/Prediction-Accomodation-Exp/data/Combined/df_params_study4_for_r.csv')

df_params <- df_params %>%
  mutate(
    overfit = as.integer(overfit),
    task = factor(
      task,
      levels = c("predict", "accommodate")
    ),
    irrelevant_dim = factor(
      irrelevant_dim,
      levels = c("feet", "stripes")
    )
  )
```

```{r}
contrasts(df_params$task)              <- contr.sum(2)
contrasts(df_params$irrelevant_dim) <- contr.sum(2)
model_overfit <- glm(
  overfit ~ task * irrelevant_dim,
  data = df_params,
  family = binomial(link = "logit")
)

summary(model_overfit)
drop1(model_overfit, test = "Chisq")
```
```{r}
df_long4 <- read_csv('/Users/sm6511/Desktop/Prediction-Accomodation-Exp/data/Combined/df_long_for_R-Study4.csv') |>
  mutate(
    task = relevel(factor(task), ref = "accommodate"),
    feature_relevance = relevel(factor(feature_relevance), ref = "relevant"),
    feature_dimension = relevel(factor(feature_dimension), ref = "feet")
  )
```

```{r}
contrasts(df_long4$task) <- contr.sum(2)
contrasts(df_long4$feature_relevance) <- contr.sum(2)
contrasts(df_long4$feature_dimension) <- contr.sum(2)

model_eff <- lmer(
  feature_importance ~ task * feature_relevance *
    feature_dimension +
    (1|participant),
  data = df_long4
)
summary(model_eff)
```
```{r}
emm <- emmeans(
  model_eff,
  ~ task * feature_relevance * feature_dimension
)

emm
pairs(
  emm,
  by = c("feature_relevance", "feature_dimension")
)
```

```{r}

model_eff <- lmer(
  abs_feature_importance ~ task * feature_relevance *
    feature_dimension +
    (1|participant),
  data = df_long4
)
summary(model_eff)
```

```{r}
df_corr <- read_csv('/Users/sm6511/Desktop/Prediction-Accomodation-Exp/data/Combined/df_corr_for_R_Study4.csv') |>
  mutate(
    task = factor(task),
    feature_relevance = factor(feature_relevance),
    feature_dimension = factor(feature_dimension)
  )
contrasts(df_corr$task) <- contr.sum(2)
contrasts(df_corr$feature_relevance) <- contr.sum(2)
contrasts(df_corr$feature_dimension) <- contr.sum(2)

model_corr_raw_eff <- lmer(
  correlation ~ task * feature_relevance * feature_dimension + (1|participant),
  data = df_corr
)

summary(model_corr_raw_eff)
```

```{r}
model_corr_raw_eff <- lmer(
  abs_correlation ~ task * feature_relevance * feature_dimension + (1|participant),
  data = df_corr
)

summary(model_corr_raw_eff)
```
